calls.title: Finalize Approach to Pricing
calls.summary: The team outlined a new strategy for open source usage, emphasizing broad access without user caps, limited to one project and two environments to encourage upgrades from free to paid plans. Open source is intended as a marketing tool rather than a fully-featured enterprise product, aiming to attract potential users. A significant shift towards event-based pricing was agreed upon for Pro and Starter plans, removing user limits and adapting the pricing structure to better reflect usage patterns. The team planned to grandfather existing users under the new caps to ease transitions. They also discussed a gradual rollout of these changes, particularly in the U.S., while addressing GDPR implications for European customers, and emphasized maintaining competitive positioning following competitor product changes.
calls.keywords: open source, event-based pricing, managed warehouse, grandfathering, feature caps, GDPR compliance
